condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: Invite all affiliated selected-group members to accept reception; grant alone is not proof of reception/display.
Group supports configurable simultaneous transmitters; maximum simultaneous transmissions in a single group is administrator-configurable, including no limit.

conditions: Requests exceed group maximum, or service-based pre-emptive capacity reasons respectively
claims.conclusion: Service selects transmitters when over maximum; it may withhold permission for capacity reasons.

limitations: Forced reception, scheduling algorithm, wire protocol and terminal capabilities not covered.
